files.pyproject.toml:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "practice-clamp-example"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = []

[tool.setuptools]
py-modules = ["clamp"]

commands:
python -c 'from setuptools.build_meta import build_wheel; build_wheel("dist")'
python -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-index --no-deps dist/practice_clamp_example-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
mkdir verify-installed
cd verify-installed
../.venv/bin/python -I -c 'from clamp import clamp; print(clamp(12, 2, 8))'
